anchor: Is there a worn trinket where an ally can tuck up to five tiers of magic, which I can release later using their own power?
I found a band already loaded with a random bit of magic that only whoever bonds to it can use. What is this item?
Which large lawful evil creature can tunnel underground, fly, and exhale a 60-foot line of crackling electricity?
Which winged monster makes three claw strikes per turn, each adding extra electric harm, and can see 120 feet in darkness?
As a level 3 sorcerer, how many magic options of level 1 or 2 can I keep ready at once, and which ability score drives them?
Whenever I gain a level, can I trade one of my ready magic for another, and can an orb or charm serve as my channel for it?
Which humanoid fighter hits so hard with a hammer that it shoves a Large or smaller foe up to 10 feet away from itself?
What humanoid hits me more easily whenever a buddy of its is standing right next to me, awake and able to act?
Which first-tier magic outlines creatures in a 20-foot cube with glowing colored light so attackers can hit them more easily?
I want to expose cloaked foes who fail a quick reflex roll so they glow and can't stay hidden. What first-level option does that?
Which huge lawful evil brute ignores burning harm and hurls a hammer that knocks a target back 15 feet and makes its next swing sloppy?
What big brute has a muscle score of 25 and gets two attacks per turn, mixing a sword strike with a hammer toss?
Which seventh-tier cleric option speaks a sacred utterance that kills foes with 20 or fewer life points and banishes otherworldly beings?
What quick one-command magic within 30 feet makes creatures with low health die, or lose sight and hearing for a while, unless they resist?
What creature hurls a 10-foot-radius burst within 30 feet, costing targets who fail a quick dodge roll 2d6 holy harm and temporary blindness?
Which monster's sight-stealing burst comes back only after rolling a 5 or 6 on a die, forcing a DC 10 reflex check?
Which uncommon crystal lenses fit over my vision to sharpen noticing things by sight and spot two-foot objects far away in clear weather?
My scout is always stuck spotting enemies in clear desert light across a canyon. Is there a crystal lens item for sharper distant sight?
Which magic stick on a d100 roll of 1 to 20 unleashes one of five random effects, like a fiery blast or a foul cloud?
Which magic stick releases a foul cloud when a 10-sided die lands on 9 or 10 after its random roll?
What large creature has a reasoning score of only 3, climbs at 40 feet, and deals 14 tearing harm on a hit?
Which large creature with 59 hit points and armor class 13 can clamber up walls and sees 60 feet in the dark?
Which first-tier divination senses toxins, nasty creatures, and magical infections within 30 feet, unless thick stone, wood, or lead blocks it?
Is there a ritual, needing a yew leaf and up to ten minutes of focus, that reveals harmful substances nearby?
Which legendary band gives me an edge in attacks against otherworldly planar beings, and can charm one within 60 feet with an 18 mental resistance roll?
What's the item tied to one of four planes of raw nature, such as air or fire, that makes those beings less accurate against me?
My cleric friend is patching up a wounded ally mid-battle. Does the ally get any extra healing that same turn from the magic?
Which divine healer ability at third level makes a healed ally get extra recovery right then, scaling up with the magic tier I spend?
Which fiend can change into a female form after a full night's sleep, and whose touch leaves a victim gaining nothing from quick breaks?
Which fiend mentally talks to others from 60 feet away and can alter its looks at will, using presence-based magic?
Which older wyrm can, between other creatures' turns, make a foe subtract a die roll from its checks after a mind-based blast?
Which wyrm can sense enchantments at will and, once per day, both lift curses and conjure a grand illusion?
Which large chaotic evil creature can climb, fly, and exhale a 30-foot cone of searing heat dealing 16d6 harm, regaining use after rolling a 5 or 6?
Which chaotic creature, sized Large, has 178 hit points and a muscle score of 23, plus 120 feet of sight in darkness?
Which small chaotic creature bursts when slain, dealing 2d6 searing harm in a 10-foot radius, and can kindle or snuff its own glow at will?
What tiny creature's touch sets a foe or combustible object alight unless it's worn or carried, and it sees 60 feet in darkness?
What lucky result from a fortune set gives me a castle to reclaim once monsters are cleared, plus expertise in a social skill?
Which arcane item sends my soul into a distant object while my body stops aging, and a wish reveals the object's location?
Which chaotic good creature can exhale a drowsy cone that knocks you out for a minute if you fail twice, and is immune to fire?
Which flier digs 15 feet and senses nearby foes without eyes, with 22 hit points and armor class 15?
Which sixth-tier necromancy lets my soul leave my body to inhabit a gem and take over a nearby humanoid within 100 feet?
Can a creature shielded by a holy ward against otherworldly beings be taken over by a mind-transfer effect cast into a gem?
Which summoned mount's slam deals holy, mind, or life-draining harm depending on its nature, and can blink 60 feet if it's a fey type?
What heavenly mount can restore 2d8 plus my magic's tier in health to a companion within 5 feet, once between full nights of sleep?
Which waistband sets my muscle score to 21 for a hill variety, or up to 29 for a storm variety, and does nothing if mine is already that high?
What worn item gives a 23 muscle score to frost or stone types, and 25 to fire types?
At high ranger level, what bonus do I get to hit the target I've tagged with my pursuit magic?
Which rare magic club adds 2d6 holy harm against infernal beings and undead, and can destroy a foe at 25 or fewer life points on a failed mental roll?
Which enchanted cudgel glows brightly in a 20-foot radius and dimly for 20 more feet while I grip it?
Which first-tier arcane trick gives me 2d4 plus 4 extra buffer health, and adds 5 more per higher tier?
Before a fight I want a quick self-buff needing just a drop of booze for its material component. What is this low-level death-magic?
Which legendary charm gives an edge on reasoning checks to control a void orb, and lets me drag it farther each turn based on my smarts?
Which top-tier keepsake lets me steer a void orb along a winding path rather than a straight line?
What very rare drink gives me a 1-minute burst of quickness and extra actions, without the sluggish crash afterward?
Which magic fluid churns by itself and looks golden with dark stripes?
Which fifth-tier restoration needs an hour of casting and a 500-gold gem to bring back someone gone up to 10 days, with a -4 penalty that fades?
Would a life-restoring magic work on a person who lost their head, or does it fail if vital body parts are missing?
Which lawful evil otherworldly brute has a chin-hair attack that doses you with toxins so you can't regain health until its next turn?
What otherworldly foe gets an edge on rolls to resist magic, shrugs off cold harm, and sees 120 feet even through magical gloom?
Which sealed vessel holds a flame-genie that grants one grand wish, then vanishes after the wish or an hour passes?
Does the sealed container keep its power once its trapped wish-giver has granted its one big wish or an hour has elapsed?
Which lawful evil creature exhales a 15-foot cone of toxic vapor dealing 6d6 harm on a failed stamina roll, and can live in both air and water?
What creature shrugs off toxin harm, can't be made sick by it, and sees 60 feet in darkness?
Which barbarian ability at level 15 refills my fury uses when I roll initiative and keeps the fury going for 10 minutes without extra effort?
What ends a barbarian's berserk fury early? Is being knocked out cold one, and does wearing plate armor count?
Which large beast moves 50 feet per turn with 17 hit points, and its chomp deals 4 blunt damage?
Which beast has reasoning score 2 and presence score 5 and ranks as a fractional threat?
Which large cat-like beast can leap up to 25 feet after a 10-foot running start and then slips away with a quick extra move?
Which creature makes two claw attacks per turn, dealing 11 cutting damage per hit, with 52 hit points and an agility score of 17?
Which undead creature can squeeze through an inch-wide gap, and its swipe saps a victim's muscle score by up to 4 points, killing them if it reaches 0?
What creature rises from the corpse of someone its swipe slays, hours later, and hides easily in dim light?
Which second-tier magic makes a 15-foot-radius ball of gloom that blocks infravision and ordinary lamplight, which a bowl over its source can stop?
If my gloom zone overlaps a rival's glowing magic of second tier or lower, does their light get snuffed out?
At top ranger tier, how big is the damage die on my tagged-prey bonus?
Which holy warrior class uses a d10 for health per level, saves on wisdom and charisma, and wears heavy armor and shields?
A new character who wants chain mail, a shield, a longsword, and six javelins at the start: which class?
At level 11, when my tagged target takes damage, can I also deal the pursuit magic's bonus harm to another foe within 30 feet, and how often?
My ranger's first arrow hits a bugbear I'm tracking, and a goblin stands 25 feet behind it. Can the extra harm hit the goblin too?
